ValidationRule.description: Deployment tasks of certain types should not be created without being associated to a user story.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.Bypass_Setting__c.Validation_Rules__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(copado__Status__c , 'Not Started')), ISBLANK(Deployment_Task__c), OR( ISPICKVAL(copado__Type__c , 'Custom Settings'), ISPICKVAL(copado__Type__c, 'Apex'), ISPICKVAL(copado__Type__c, 'Manual Task'), ISPICKVAL(copado__Type__c, 'Full Profiles'), ISPICKVAL(copado__Type__c, 'Full Permission Sets'), ISPICKVAL(copado__Type__c,'Delete MetaData') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This type of Deployment Task must be associated to a User Story
